collectionMethod: Manual capture of the official OpenCode Go docs page and landing page (English) around 10:40 Beijing time / 02:40Z on 2026-10-25, compared against the 2026-10-24 capture of the same pages. Official per-model pricing table, per-model Monthly limit, the usage-window rule, the official 'Estimated requests' table, the landing-page Go model table and the privacy table were read as published. Research-only — no adopted row generated, no adopted value changed, no script changed.
scope: OpenCode Go official price table only. One catalog entry changed on 2026-10-25: 'Gemini 4 Argon Contributor' (model id gemini-4-argon-contributor) became 'Gemini 4 Argon' (model id gemini-4-argon), and the '2x · Limited time' promotion on that row was replaced by a dated '50% off' discount. The landing-page model counter stayed at 'View all 30 models'. No leaderboard/score data, no Command Code GOAT change (cross-channel note only), no shared-pool change, no other OpenCode model row changed, no adopted.csv row.
adoptionStatus: research-only; not adopted; the existing opencode_go × gemini-4-argon-contributor row is generated by scripts/build_adopted.py OPENCODE_GO_MODELS — renaming it to gemini-4-argon and deciding whether the dated 50%-off promotion (through 2026-11-30) applies under the promotions convention are left to maintainer review
